tagline: the real cost of a used car
storage_hint: Disk used by the installation (Raspberry Pi limit)
fuel_stale: The fuel price is more than 30 days old
load_failed: The data could not be loaded.
footer: Unknown values are shown as pending, never as 0. Notes and the log are kept in English; listing captures stay in their original language.
open_dossier_aria: Open the dossier and photos of {u}
delta_help: Only computed when both this car and your car have a complete TCO; comparing partial subtotals would mislead.
price_change_title: Change of the asking price since the first capture ({d})
units_lead: Every car for sale against the one you own: costs over the period you chose, {n} cost components, and the score from your ranking weights.
ranking_hint: The score comes from the questionnaire and the weights on the Ranking page.
no_units: No cars yet. An agent registers listings through the API.
pin_ref: Pin my car at the top
hide_over_budget: Hide cars over the maximum budget
composition_lead: {y} · {km} km. Hover a segment to see the amount.
cost_pick_lead: Choose which costs count; cars missing any selected cost are marked incomplete and go last.
chart_note: Common scale for every car. Pending amounts have no size because they are unknown; the Details view is the data view.
dep_help: Candidate: asking price − resale at the end. Your car: sale today − resale at the end (the opportunity cost of keeping it).
be_title: Break-even: keep your car or switch
be_lead: Month-by-month cash view. Buying starts with the upfront outlay (price + purchase costs − what your car fetches today) and adds the car's running costs; keeping adds your car's. Where the lines cross, the switch has paid for itself. At the end each line drops by its resale value.
be_missing_title: Data is still missing for these cars:
be_note: Running costs (fuel, insurance, tax, maintenance, repairs, tyres) are spread evenly over the months; repairs and tyres are not dated yet. The vertical drop in the last month is the resale value (and, for your car, its selling costs).
be_hi_lead: Cars in the chart (click a car to show or hide it; the table lists all):
be_hi_hint: Show or hide this car in the chart
preview_banner: Preview: the parameters have been changed in Settings but not saved.
ranking_lead: Answer the questions and the weights follow; the score of every car is explained criterion by criterion. Criteria never overlap: fuel, insurance and tax live inside the total cost. Missing data lowers the coverage, it never counts as 0. Your own car is not ranked.
need_two: The ranking needs at least two cars for sale with data in the weighted criteria.
quiz_lead: Eight questions with fixed answers. Each answer adds points to criteria; the sum (0–5) is the weight. The same questions in every language.
weights_lead: Derived from your answers. You can still move a slider; the ranking then shows it was edited by hand.
ranking_edit: Change the questionnaire or the weights
formula_text: For each criterion with weight > 0 and at least two cars with a value: score = (value − worst) ÷ (best − worst), so the best car gets 100. Car score = Σ weight × score ÷ Σ weights of the criteria this car has a value for. Coverage = the share of the total weight that could be scored.
why_fewer_than_two_cars_with_a_value: fewer than two cars with a value
cb_cost_month: Complete TCO ÷ months: fuel, insurance, tax, maintenance, repairs, tyres, purchase/sale and depreciation. Unknown while a component is missing.
cb_cash_now: Asking price plus the purchase costs of this car.
cb_reliability: Severity points of the documented watch points of the variant, its engine and its generation (HIGH 3, MEDIUM 2, LOW-MEDIUM 1, LOW 0.5, HIGH IF APPLICABLE 1.5). Fewer is better.
cb_inspection: Checklist items marked as a problem at a viewing; unknown until something was checked.
cb_simplicity: Naturally aspirated +1, port injection +1, timing chain +1 (dry belt +0.5, wet belt 0), manual gearbox +1. Unknown while any field is unknown.
cb_confidence: Average evidence quality of the rows behind the costs: verified or official data and A/B sources score high, estimates and D sources low.
q_cash: How tight is the cash for buying?
a_cash_some_room: I have a budget with some room
a_cash_long_run: The price matters less than what the car costs over the years
q_running: How much do the monthly running costs matter over the years you will keep the car?
q_trouble: How do you feel about a car that may need unplanned repairs?
a_trouble_peace: I want peace of mind, even if it costs more
a_trouble_some_risk: Some risk is fine if the price is right
a_trouble_diy: I can fix things myself; risk is fine
q_wear: How much do mileage and age matter beyond their effect on costs?
a_wear_costs_only: Not by themselves, only through the costs
a_drive_enough: Enough to keep up on the motorway
q_simple: Do you prefer simple, proven mechanics (no turbo, port injection, manual gearbox)?
q_viewing: How much weight should what was found when viewing a car have?
a_viewing_not_yet: I have not viewed cars yet
q_evidence: Should well-documented numbers count more than estimates?
a_evidence_prefer_backed: Prefer cars whose numbers are backed by good sources
gaps_note: The agent's to-do list (always in English).
mp_lead: Scheduled jobs for your period ({km} km, {m} months). Each job counts period ÷ interval (an expected value: a used car's position in its cycle is unknown); a job done at purchase restarts its schedule.
mp_none: No item schedule for this model yet.
rk_lead: Each risk fails with a probability somewhere in a km window; the car is exposed to the share of the window it drives through in your period.
viewing_hint: Tick the checklist, write notes and take photos while looking at the car. Everything is saved at once.
log_ph: Note for the log (in English, please)
no_reliability: No reliability data for this model.
no_archive: No captures yet. Once the listing is archived, its description, features and photos stay here even after it disappears.
dossier_failed: The dossier could not be loaded: {m}
level_hint: The level this row is attached to: the variant, its engine or its generation
levels_hint: a row attached to an engine or a generation applies to every variant that shares it
models_lead: Make → model → generation → engine → variant. Maintenance, risks and watch points are attached to the right level and inherited by every variant below.
title: Title
sources_lead: Every data point is linked to a source with a quality A–D (A official, B ADAC/TÜV/manuals, C aggregators, D forums and snippets).
settings_lead: The assumptions behind every cost in the comparison, the look of the app and your account.
calc_group_hint: Changes preview immediately in the comparison; nothing is saved until you press Save.
profile_hint: The profile used for insurance quotes (by the agent). It does not enter the cost calculation.
appearance_hint: Every theme shows the same data in the same places; only the look changes. Remembered in this browser.
theme_blueprint_hint: Paper, navy ink, drawing grid; night shift in dark mode
theme_clean_hint: White, one accent, lots of air
theme_garage_hint: Asphalt black, signal yellow, tyre-tread texture; dark only
theme_swiss_hint: White, black grotesk, thin rules, one red
theme_terminal_hint: Phosphor green and amber on black, monospace
theme_ledger_hint: Ruled paper, ink-blue handwriting, red margin
theme_rally_hint: Navy with magenta and cyan, racing stripes
theme_olive_hint: Olive, brass and cream, workshop-manual feel
theme_contrast_hint: Black and white only, thick borders, large type
agent_token_hint: The token an agent uses to write data into this account (Authorization: Bearer). It is shown once; creating a new one disables the old one.
token_shown_once: Copy it now; it will not be shown again.
admin_lead: Create accounts and hand over the invite link; the person sets their password on it. Every account has its own data.
create_invite: Create and get the invite link
invite_created: Invite link for {u} (valid 72 hours, one use):
